x: Shāh Bahāʾuddīn Naqshband · d. 791 AH / 1389 CE
The founder’s own wird: the tasbīḥ of the Names, the Throne Verse and the seven ḥā-mīms, the ninety-nine Names told in full, and the long ṣalāt at the close.
Bismi llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm
In the name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful.

اَللّٰهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ الْـحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ الْـحَقُّ الْمُبِيْنُ، اَلَّذِيْ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّـيْ، خَلَقْتَنِـيْ وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَاَنَا عَلىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، اَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوْءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوْءُ بِذَنْۢبِـيْ، فَاغْفِرْلِـيْ ذُنُوْبِـيْ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ يَا غَفَّارُ.

Allāhumma anta l-Maliku l-Ḥayyu l-Qayyūmu l-Ḥaqqu l-Mubīn, alladhī lā ilāha illā ant. Anta rabbī, khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduk, wa anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mā staṭaʿt. Aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt; abūʾu laka bi-niʿmatika ʿalayya, wa abūʾu bi-dhanbī. Fa-ghfir lī dhunūbī, fa-innahu lā yaghfiru dh-dhunūba illā anta yā Ghaffār.

O Allāh, You are the King, the Living, the Self-Subsisting, the Real, the Manifest — there is no god but You. You are my Lord; You created me and I am Your servant, and I hold to Your covenant and Your promise as much as I am able. I take refuge in You from the evil of what I have done; I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin. So forgive me my sins, for none forgives sins but You, O Ever-Forgiving.

سُبْحَانَ الـلّٰـهِ وَالْـحَمْدُ لِـلّٰهِ وَلَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا الـلّٰـهُ وَالـلّٰـهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِالـلّٰـهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ ﴿ هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيْمٌ ﴾ .

Subḥāna llāhi wa l-ḥamdu li-llāhi wa lā ilāha illā llāhu wa llāhu akbar; wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīm. ﴿Huwa l-Awwalu wa l-Ākhiru wa ẓ-Ẓāhiru wa l-Bāṭinu wa huwa bi-kulli shayʾin ʿalīm﴾.

Glory be to Allāh; praise be to Allāh; there is no god but Allāh; Allāh is greatest. And there is no power and no strength save by Allāh, the Most High, the Magnificent. ⟨He is the First and the Last, the Outward and the Inward, and He is Knower of all things.⟩

لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا الـلّٰـهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَريْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْـحَمْدُ، يُـحْيِيْ وَيُـمِيْتُ، وَهُوَ الْـحَيُّ الَّذِيْ لَا يَـمُوْتُ بِيَدِهِ الْـخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ.
Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah; lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-ḥamd; yuḥyī wa yumīt; wa huwa l-Ḥayyu lladhī lā yamūt; bi-yadihi l-khayr; wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

There is no god but Allāh alone, who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and gives death, and He is the Living who does not die. In His hand is all good, and He has power over all things.
سُبْحَانَكَ يَا عَظِيْمَ الْمُعَظَّمِ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا قَيُّوْمَ الْمُكَرَّمِ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا بَاعِثُ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا وَارِثُ،
Subḥānaka yā ʿAẓīma l-muʿaẓẓam, subḥānaka yā Qayyūma l-mukarram, subḥānaka yā Bāʿith, subḥānaka yā Wārith,
Glory be to You, O Magnificent One who is magnified; glory be to You, O Self-Subsisting One who is honoured; glory be to You, O Raiser of the dead; glory be to You, O Inheritor of all,
سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مُقْتَدِرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا عَالِـمَ السِّرِّ وَالْـخَفِيَّاتِ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا بَاعِثَ مَنْ فِى الْـجَدَالَةِ الْمُسْمَكَاتِ،
subḥānaka yā Muqtadir, subḥānaka yā ʿĀlima s-sirri wa l-khafiyyāt, subḥānaka yā Bāʿitha man fī l-jadālati l-musmakāt,
glory be to You, O All-Powerful; glory be to You, O Knower of the secret and of hidden things; glory be to You, O Raiser of whoever lies in the earth beneath the raised heavens,
سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مَعْبُوْدَ جَمِيْعِ الْـخَلَائِقِ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مُقَدِّرَ الْوَجْدِ وَالصَّوَافِقِ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مَنْ لَّا تَطْرَأُ عَلَيْهِ الْآفَاتُ،
subḥānaka yā Maʿbūda jamīʿi l-khalāʾiq, subḥānaka yā Muqaddira l-wajdi wa ṣ-ṣawāfiq, subḥānaka yā man lā taṭraʾu ʿalayhi l-āfāt,
glory be to You, O One worshipped by all creatures; glory be to You, O Ordainer of finding and of what strikes; glory be to You, O One upon whom no blights come,
سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مُكَوِّنَ الْأَزْمِنَةِ وَالْأَوْقَاتِ، عَلَا قَدْرُكَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ عَمَّا يَقُوْلُ الظَّالِمُوْنَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيْرًا.
subḥānaka yā Mukawwina l-azminati wa l-awqāt. ʿAlā qadruka wa taʿālayta ʿammā yaqūlu ẓ-ẓālimūna ʿuluwwan kabīrā.
glory be to You, O Bringer-into-being of the ages and the hours. Your measure is exalted, and You are far above what the wrongdoers say — immeasurably high.
سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مُعْتِقَ الرِّقَابِ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مُسَبِّبَ الْأَسْبَابِ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ الَّذِي لَا يَـمُوْتُ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا إِلَـٰهِيْ وَإِلَـٰهَ النَّاسُوْتِ.
Subḥānaka yā Muʿtiqa r-riqāb, subḥānaka yā Musabbiba l-asbāb, subḥānaka yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūmu lladhī lā yamūt, subḥānaka yā Ilāhī wa Ilāha n-nāsūt.
Glory be to You, O Freer of necks; glory be to You, O Ordainer of causes; glory be to You, O Living, O Self-Subsisting who does not die; glory be to You, O my God and God of the human world.

خَلَقْتَنَا رَبَّنَا بِيَدِكَ، وَفَضَّلْتَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيْرٍ مِّنْ خَلْقِكَ، فَلَكَ الْـحَمْدُ وَالنَّعْمَآءُ، وَلَكَ الطَّوْلُ وَالْآمَآءُ وَالْآلَاءُ، تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ، نَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَنَتُوْبُ إِلَيْكَ.
Khalaqtanā Rabbanā bi-yadik, wa faḍḍaltanā ʿalā kathīrin min khalqik. Fa-laka l-ḥamdu wa n-naʿmāʾ, wa laka ṭ-ṭawlu wa l-āmāʾu wa l-ālāʾ. Tabārakta Rabbanā wa taʿālayt; nastaghfiruka wa natūbu ilayk.

You created us, our Lord, with Your hand, and preferred us over much of Your creation. So Yours is the praise and the bounties, and Yours the abundance, the gifts and the favours. Blessed are You, our Lord, and exalted. We seek Your forgiveness and turn to You.
اَللّٰهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَا شَيْءَ قَبْلَكَ، وَأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَا شَيْءَ بَعْدَكَ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَا شَيْءَ يُشْبِهُكَ،
Allāhumma anta l-Awwalu fa-lā shayʾa qablak, wa anta l-Ākhiru fa-lā shayʾa baʿdak, wa anta ẓ-Ẓāhiru fa-lā shayʾa yushbihuk,
O Allāh, You are the First, so there is nothing before You; and You are the Last, so there is nothing after You; and You are the Outward, so there is nothing resembling You,
وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَا شَيْءَ يَرَاكَ، وَأَنْتَ الْوَاحِدُ بِلَا كَثِيْرٍ، وَأَنْتَ الْقَادِرُ بِلَا وَزِيْرٍ،
wa anta l-Bāṭinu fa-lā shayʾa yarāk. Wa anta l-Wāḥidu bi-lā kathīr, wa anta l-Qādiru bi-lā wazīr,
and You are the Inward, so nothing sees You. You are the One without multiplicity, and the Able without any minister,
وَأَنْتَ الْمُدَبِّرُ بِلَا مُشِيْرٍ ﴿قُلِ اَللّٰهُمَّ مَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى الْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشَآءُ وَتَنْزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِـمَّنْ تَشَآءُ،
wa anta l-Mudabbiru bi-lā mushīr. ﴿Quli llāhumma Mālika l-mulki tuʾtī l-mulka man tashāʾu wa tanziʿu l-mulka mimman tashāʾ,
and You are the Governor without any counsellor. ⟨Say: O Allāh, Owner of all dominion, You give dominion to whom You will and take dominion from whom You will,
وَتُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشَآءُ بِيَدِكَ الْـخَيْرُ، إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ﴾﴿تُوْلِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِى النَّهَارِ وَتُوْلِجُ النَّهَارَ فِى اللَّيْلِ،
wa tuʿizzu man tashāʾu wa tudhillu man tashāʾ, bi-yadika l-khayr; innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr﴾ ﴿Tūliju l-layla fī n-nahāri wa tūliju n-nahāra fī l-layl,
and You exalt whom You will and abase whom You will. In Your hand is all good; You have power over all things.⟩ ⟨You make the night pass into the day and the day pass into the night,
وَتُـخْرِجُ الْـحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَتُـخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْـحَيِّ، وَتَرْزُقُ مَنْ تَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ﴾ سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مَنِ احْتَجَبَ فِى الْأُوْلَـىٰ عَنْ جَمِيْعِ الْوَرٰى،
wa tukhriju l-ḥayya mina l-mayyiti wa tukhriju l-mayyita mina l-ḥayy, wa tarzuqu man tashāʾu bi-ghayri ḥisāb﴾. Subḥānaka yā mani ḥtajaba fī l-ūlā ʿan jamīʿi l-warā,
and You bring forth the living from the dead and the dead from the living, and You provide for whom You will without reckoning.⟩ Glory be to You, O One veiled from the first from all mankind,
سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مَنْ تَرَدَّىٰ بِالْوَقَارِ وَالْكِبْرِيَآءِ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مَالِكَ جَمِيْعِ الْأَشْيَآءِ،
subḥānaka yā man taraddā bi-l-waqāri wa l-kibriyāʾ, subḥānaka yā Mālika jamīʿi l-ashyāʾ,
glory be to You, O One who is mantled in gravity and grandeur; glory be to You, O Owner of all things,
سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مَنْ تَعَزَّزَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ وَالْعُلَىٰ، وَيَا مَنْ يَّعْلَمُ مَا فِى الضَّوَاحِي السَّبْعِ وَالْـحُسْنَـىٰ،
subḥānaka yā man taʿazzaza bi-l-qudrati wa l-ʿulā, wa yā man yaʿlamu mā fī ḍ-ḍawāḥī s-sabʿi wa l-ḥusnā,
glory be to You, O One mighty through power and loftiness; O One who knows what lies in the seven expanses and in what is fairest,
وَيَا مَنْ يَّعْلَمُ مَا يَتَلَجْلَجُ فِي الصُّدُوْرِ وَالْأَحْشَآءِ، وَيَا مَنْ شَرَّفَ الْعُرُوْضَ عَلَى الْمُدُنِ وَالْقُرَىٰ،
wa yā man yaʿlamu mā yatalajlaju fī ṣ-ṣudūri wa l-aḥshāʾ, wa yā man sharrafa l-ʿurūḍa ʿalā l-muduni wa l-qurā,
and O One who knows what stirs unspoken in breasts and innermost parts; and O One who has ennobled the open lands above the cities and the villages,
سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مَنْ يَّعْلَمُ مَا تَـحْتَ الْـجَبُوْبِ وَالثَّرَىٰ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا مَنْ تَعَالَـىٰ وَلَطُفَ عَنْ أَنْ يُّرَىٰ،
subḥānaka yā man yaʿlamu mā taḥta l-jabūbi wa th-tharā, subḥānaka yā man taʿālā wa laṭufa ʿan an yurā,
glory be to You, O One who knows what lies beneath the hard ground and the moist earth; glory be to You, O One too exalted and too subtle to be seen,
تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، لَا رَبَّ غَيْرُكَ، وَلَا قَاهِرَ سِوَاكَ. اَللّٰهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمُنْعِمُ الْمُفَضِّلُ الْمُقِيْلُ الشَّكُوْرُ.
tabārakta wa taʿālayt; lā rabba ghayruk, wa lā qāhira siwāk. Allāhumma anta l-Munʿimu l-Mufaḍḍilu l-Muqīlu sh-Shakūr.
blessed and exalted are You; there is no Lord but You, and none who overpowers besides You. O Allāh, You are the Bestower of blessing, the Giver of favour, the Pardoner, the Appreciative.
وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ الـلّٰـهُ الَّذِيْ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّـيْ وَرَبُّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ،
Wa ashhadu annaka anta llāhu lladhī lā ilāha illā ant. Anta rabbī wa rabbu kulli shayʾ,
And I bear witness that You are Allāh, other than whom there is no god. You are my Lord and the Lord of all things,

فَاطِرُ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِـمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيْرُ الْمُتَعَالِ ﴿ طٰهٰ ﴾ ﴿ طٰسٓمٓ ﴾ ﴿ طٰسٓ ﴾ ﴿ يٰسٓ ﴾ ﴿ حٰمٓعٓسٓقٓ ﴾ ﴿ مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ ﴾ ﴿ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ ﴾ ﴿اَلـلّٰـهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْـحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ،

fāṭiru s-samāwāti wa l-arḍ, ʿālimu l-ghaybi wa sh-shahādah, al-ʿAliyyu l-Kabīru l-Mutaʿāl. ﴿Ṭā Hā﴾ ﴿Ṭā Sīn Mīm﴾ ﴿Ṭā Sīn﴾ ﴿Yā Sīn﴾ ﴿Ḥā Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf﴾ ﴿Maraja l-baḥrayni yaltaqiyān﴾ ﴿Baynahumā barzakhun lā yabghiyān﴾ ﴿Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-Ḥayyu l-Qayyūm,

Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Most High, the Great, the Exalted. ⟨Ṭā Hā⟩ ⟨Ṭā Sīn Mīm⟩ ⟨Ṭā Sīn⟩ ⟨Yā Sīn⟩ ⟨Ḥā Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf⟩ ⟨He let loose the two seas, meeting together⟩ ⟨between them a barrier they do not overpass⟩ ⟨Allāh — there is no god but He, the Living, the Self-Subsisting,
لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَّلَا نَوْمٌ، لَهُ مَا فِى السَّمٰوَاتِ وَمَا فِى الْأَرْضِ، مَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ،
lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun wa lā nawm; lahu mā fī s-samāwāti wa mā fī l-arḍ; man dhā lladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnih,
neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep; to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth; who is there that can intercede with Him except by His leave?
يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ، وَلَا يُـحِيْطُوْنَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِـمَا شَآءَ،
yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa lā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin min ʿilmihi illā bi-mā shāʾ,
He knows what lies before them and what lies behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except as He wills,
وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ، وَلَا يَؤُوْدُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا، وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ﴾ حٰمٓ حٰمٓ حٰمٓ حٰمٓ حٰمٓ حٰمٓ حٰمٓ،
wasiʿa kursiyyuhu s-samāwāti wa l-arḍ, wa lā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā, wa huwa l-ʿAliyyu l-ʿAẓīm﴾. Ḥā Mīm, Ḥā Mīm, Ḥā Mīm, Ḥā Mīm, Ḥā Mīm, Ḥā Mīm, Ḥā Mīm,
His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation does not weary Him; and He is the Most High, the Magnificent.⟩ Ḥā Mīm — seven times,

حُمَّ الْأَمْرُ وَجَاءَ النَّصْرُ، فَعَلَيْنَا لَا يُنْصَرُوْنَ ﴿ حٰمٓ تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ الـلّٰـهِ الْعَزِيْزِ الْعَلِيْمِ ﴾ ﴿غَافِرِ الذَّنْۢبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيْدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوْلِ،
ḥumma l-amru wa jāʾa n-naṣr, fa-ʿalaynā lā yunṣarūn. ﴿Ḥā Mīm. Tanzīlu l-kitābi mina llāhi l-ʿAzīzi l-ʿAlīm﴾ ﴿Ghāfiri dh-dhanbi wa qābili t-tawbi shadīdi l-ʿiqābi dhī ṭ-ṭawl,

the matter is decreed and the help has come; against us they shall not be helped. ⟨Ḥā Mīm. The sending down of the Book is from Allāh, the Mighty, the All-Knowing⟩ ⟨Forgiver of sin, Accepter of repentance, severe in punishment, Possessor of abundance,
لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيْرُ﴾ يَفْعَلُ الـلّٰـهُ مَا يَشَآءُ بِقُدْرَتِهِ، وَيَـحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيْدُ بِعِزَّتِهِ،
lā ilāha illā huwa ilayhi l-maṣīr﴾. Yafʿalu llāhu mā yashāʾu bi-qudratih, wa yaḥkumu mā yurīdu bi-ʿizzatih,
there is no god but He; to Him is the journey's end.⟩ Allāh does what He wills by His power, and decrees what He intends by His might,

وَلَا مُنَازِعَ لَهُ فِـيْ جَبَرُوْتِهِ وَلَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ فـيْ مُلْكِهِ. سُبْحَانَ الـلّٰـهِ وَبِـحَمْدِهِ، لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِالـلّٰـهِ مَا شَآءَ الـلّٰـهُ كَانَ وَمَا لَـمْ يَشَأْ لَـمْ يَكُنْ، اَعْلَمُ اَنَّ الـلّٰـهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ، وَأَنَّ الـلّٰـهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا.

wa lā munāziʿa lahu fī jabarūtih, wa lā sharīka lahu fī mulkih. Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih; lā quwwata illā bi-llāh. Mā shāʾa llāhu kāna wa mā lam yashaʾ lam yakun. Aʿlamu anna llāha ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr, wa anna llāha qad aḥāṭa bi-kulli shayʾin ʿilmā.

and none contends with Him in His compelling power, and He has no partner in His dominion. Glory be to Allāh and praise be to Him; there is no strength save by Allāh. What Allāh wills comes to be, and what He does not will does not come to be. I know that Allāh has power over all things, and that Allāh has encompassed all things in knowledge.
اللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَقْتُلْنَا بِغَضَبِكَ، وَلَا تُـهْلِكْنَا بِـمَثُلَاتِكَ، وَعَافِنَا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ، سُبْحَانَ الـلّٰـهِ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوْسِ،
Allāhumma lā taqtulnā bi-ghaḍabik, wa lā tuhliknā bi-mathulātik, wa ʿāfinā qabla dhālik. Subḥāna llāhi l-Maliki l-Quddūs,
O Allāh, do not destroy us in Your anger, nor bring us to ruin by Your exemplary punishments; grant us well-being before that. Glory be to Allāh, the King, the All-Holy,

سُبْحَانَ الـلّٰـهِ ذِى الْمُلْكِ وَالْمَلَكُوْتِ، سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْعِزَّةِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ وَالْـهَيْبَةِ وَالْقُدْرَةِ وَالْكِبْرِيَآءِ وَالْـجَلَالِ وَالْـجَمَالِ وَالْكَمَالِ وَالْبَقَآءِ وَالسُّلْطَانِ وَالْـجَبَرُوْتِ،
subḥāna llāhi Dhī l-mulki wa l-malakūt; subḥāna Dhī l-ʿizzati wa l-ʿaẓamati wa l-haybati wa l-qudrati wa l-kibriyāʾi wa l-jalāli wa l-jamāli wa l-kamāli wa l-baqāʾi wa s-sulṭāni wa l-jabarūt,

glory be to Allāh, Possessor of dominion and of the unseen kingdom; glory be to the Possessor of might, immensity, awe, power, grandeur, majesty, beauty, perfection, everlastingness, sovereignty and compelling power,
سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْـحَيِّ الَّذِيْ لَا يَنَامُ وَلَا يَـمُوْتُ، أَبَدًا بَاقِيًا دَآئِمًا، سُبُّوْحٌ قُدُّوْسُ،
subḥāna l-Maliki l-Ḥayyi lladhī lā yanāmu wa lā yamūt, abadan bāqiyan dāʾimā. Subbūḥun Quddūsun,
glory be to the King, the Living, who neither sleeps nor dies, everlastingly abiding and enduring. All-Glorified, All-Holy,

رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّ الْمَلَآئِكَةِ وَالرُّوْحِ. اللّٰهُمَّ عَلِّمْنَا مِنْ عِلْمِكَ، وَفَهِّمْنَا عَنْكَ وَقَلِّدْنَا بِصَمْصَامِ نَصْرِكَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا لَكَ شَاكِرًا، وَلَكَ ذَاكِرًا، وَلَكَ رَاهِبًا، وَلَكَ مِطْوَاعًا، وَلَكَ مُـخْبِتًا، وَإِلَيْكَ أَوَّاهًا مُّنِيْبًا.

Rabbunā wa Rabbu l-malāʾikati wa r-rūḥ. Allāhumma ʿallimnā min ʿilmik, wa fahhimnā ʿank, wa qallidnā bi-ṣamṣāmi naṣrik. Allāhumma jʿalnā laka shākiran, wa laka dhākiran, wa laka rāhiban, wa laka miṭwāʿan, wa laka mukhbitan, wa ilayka awwāhan munībā.

our Lord and the Lord of the angels and the Spirit. O Allāh, teach us from Your knowledge, and give us understanding from You, and gird us with the keen sword of Your help. O Allāh, make us thankful to You, remembering You, in awe of You, obedient to You, humbled before You, and turning to You in sighing and repentance.
اَللّٰهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ تَوْبَتَنَا، وَاغْسِلْ حَوْبَتَنَا، وَسَدِّدْ مَقَاوِلَنَا، وَاسْلُلْ سَخِيْمَةَ صُدُوْرِنَا.
Allāhumma taqabbal tawbatanā, wa ghsil ḥawbatanā, wa saddid maqāwilanā, wa slul sakhīmata ṣudūrinā,
O Allāh, accept our repentance, and wash away our guilt, and make our speech sound, and draw out the rancour from our breasts,

وَأَذْهِبِ الدَّخَلَ وَالرَّانَ وَالْاِحْنَةَ مِنْ قُلُوْبِنَا. اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُبِكَ مِنْ جُدَاعِ الْفُجّاةِ، وَحَرْقِ الْمَانُوْسَةِ، وَمِنَ الْإِلْـحَادِ وَالْفِرَّةِ وَمِنَ الْـجَمَ وَالْعَنَةِ وَمِنَ الْأُمُوْرِ الْمُطَهَّرَاتِ.

wa adhhibi d-dakhala wa r-rāna wa l-iḥnata min qulūbinā. Allāhumma innā naʿūdhu bika min judāʿi l-fujʾah, wa ḥarqi l-mānūsah, wa mina l-ilḥādi wa l-firrah, wa mina l-jama wa l-ʿanah, wa mina l-umūri l-muṭahharāt.

and remove the corruption, the rust and the malice from our hearts. O Allāh, we take refuge in You from sudden ruin, from the fire that consumes, from unbelief and from flight, from the gathering of trouble and from hardship, and from matters that ought to be kept pure.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اقْسِمُ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا تَـحُوْلُ بِهِ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيَكَ، وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُدْخِلُنَا وَتُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ إِلَـىٰ حَضِيْرَةِ الْقُدْسِ،
Allāhumma qsim lanā min khashyatika mā taḥūlu bihi baynanā wa bayna maʿāṣīk, wa min ṭāʿatika mā tudkhilunā wa tuballighunā bihi ilā ḥaẓīrati l-quds,
O Allāh, apportion to us of fear of You such as will come between us and disobedience to You, and of obedience to You such as will bring us into and deliver us to the enclosure of holiness,
وَمِنَ الْيَقِيْنِ مَا تُـهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مُصِيْبَاتِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَاحْشُرْنَا مَعَ خَيْرِ الْأَشَاوِنِ،
wa mina l-yaqīni mā tuhawwinu bihi ʿalaynā muṣībāti d-dunyā wa l-ākhirah; wa ḥshurnā maʿa khayri l-ashāwin,
and of certainty such as will make light for us the afflictions of this world and the next; and gather us with the best of company,
وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْـمَاعِنَا، وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا، وَمَوْتُنَا عَلَىٰ مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا،
wa mattiʿnā bi-asmāʿinā wa abṣārinā wa quwwatinā mā aḥyaytanā, wa mawtunā ʿalā mā aḥyaytanā,
and let us enjoy our hearing, our sight and our strength as long as You keep us alive, and let our dying be upon that in which You kept us alive,
وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنًا، وَاجْعَلُ فَأَرَنَا عَلَىٰ مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا، وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَىٰ مَنْ عَادَانَا، وَاغْفِرْ خَطَايَانًا،
wa jʿalhu l-wāritha minnā; wa jʿal thaʾranā ʿalā man ẓalamanā, wa nṣurnā ʿalā man ʿādānā, wa ghfir khaṭāyānā,
and make it what survives of us; and let our redress be against whoever has wronged us, and give us victory over whoever has shown us enmity, and forgive our faults,
واكْشِفُ زَوَايَانَا، وَاشْفِ مَرْضَانَا، وَنَوَرْ جُوْشُوْشَنَا، وَاقْضِ أَوْطَارَنَا، وَارْحَمْ نَا جِلَيْنَا،
wa kshif zawāyānā, wa shfi marḍānā, wa nawwir juyūbanā, wa qḍi awṭāranā, wa rḥam nājilīnā,
and uncover for us what is hidden in our corners, and heal our sick, and illumine our inmost recesses, and fulfil our purposes, and have mercy on those who begot us,
وَلَا تَـجْعَلِ الْعَاجِلَةَ اكْبَرَ هَـمِّنَا وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا، وَلَا تَـجْعَلْ مُصِيْبَتَنَا فِـيْ دِيْنِنَا وَدُنْيَانَا،
wa lā tajʿali l-ʿājilata akbara hamminā wa lā mablagha ʿilminā, wa lā tajʿal muṣībatanā fī dīninā wa dunyānā,
and do not make this fleeting world our greatest care nor the sum of our knowledge, and do not place our affliction in our religion or in our worldly life,

وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا بِذُنُوْبِنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا وَارْزُقْنَا، وَأَنْتَ اَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ. اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ رَحْمَةٌ مِّنْ عِنْدِكَ تُـهْدِى بِـهَا رَوْعَنَا، وَتَكُمْ بِـهَا شَعْتَنَا، وَتَـجْمَعُ بِـهَا شَـمْلَنَا، وَتَشْفِيْ بِـهَا مَرِيْضَنَا، وَتُزَكِّيْ بِـهَا أَعْمَالَنَا وَأَوْقَاتِنَا، وَتُلْهِمُنَا بِـهَا رُشْدَنَا.

wa lā tusalliṭ ʿalaynā bi-dhunūbinā man lā yarḥamunā, wa rzuqnā, wa anta Arḥamu r-rāḥimīn. Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka raḥmatan min ʿindika tahdī bihā rawʿanā, wa talummu bihā shaʿthanā, wa tajmaʿu bihā shamlanā, wa tashfī bihā marīḍanā, wa tuzakkī bihā aʿmālanā wa awqātanā, wa tulhimunā bihā rushdanā.

and do not, because of our sins, set over us one who will show us no mercy; and provide for us, for You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy. O Allāh, we ask You for a mercy from Your presence by which You still our alarm, and gather up what is scattered of us, and unite what is dispersed of us, and heal our sick, and purify our deeds and our hours, and inspire in us our right course.
اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ بِصَمَدَانِيَّتِكَ وَبِوَحْدَانِيَّتِكَ وَبِفَرْدَانِيَّتِكَ، وَبِعِزَّتِكَ الْبَاهِرَةِ،
Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka bi-ṣamadāniyyatika wa bi-waḥdāniyyatika wa bi-fardāniyyatik, wa bi-ʿizzatika l-bāhirah,
O Allāh, we ask You by Your eternal self-sufficiency, by Your oneness and by Your singularity, and by Your dazzling might,

وَبِرَحْمَتِكَ الْوَاسِعَةِ، أَنْ تَـجْعَلَ لَنَا نُورًا فِـيْ مَسَامِعِنَا وَنُوْرًا فِـيْ أَعْيُنِنَا، وَنُوْرًا فِـيْ أَجْدَآئِنَا الـلّٰـهُ الرَّحِيْمُ عِنْدَ السَّامِ حَسْبُنَا الـلّٰـهُ الرَّوْفُ عِنْدَ الْمَسْئَلَةِ فِـي الْـجَدَثِ،
wa bi-raḥmatika l-wāsiʿah, an tajʿala lanā nūran fī masāmiʿinā wa nūran fī aʿyuninā, wa nūran fī ajdāʾinā. Allāhu r-Raḥīmu ʿinda s-sām; ḥasbunā llāhu r-Raʾūfu ʿinda l-masʾalati fī l-jadath,

and by Your all-embracing mercy, that You make for us a light in our hearing and a light in our eyes and a light in our bodies. Allāh is the Merciful at the moment of death; Allāh the Most Kind suffices us at the questioning in the grave,
وَنُوْرًا فِـيْ قُلُوْبِنَا، وَنُوْرًا فِـيْ حَوَاتِنَا، وَنُوْرًا فِـيْ نَسَمِنَا، وَنُوْرًا مِّنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيْنَا.
wa nūran fī qulūbinā, wa nūran fī ḥawāyānā, wa nūran fī nasaminā, wa nūran min bayni aydīnā.
and a light in our hearts, and a light in our inward parts, and a light in our breath, and a light before us.
اَللّٰهُمَّ زِدْنَا عِلْمًا وَّنُوْرًا وَّحِلْمًا، وَآتِنَا نِعْمَةً ظَاهِرَةٌ وَّنِعْمَةٌ بَاطِنَةٌ، حَسْبُنَا الـلّٰـهُ لِدِيْنِنَا،
Allāhumma zidnā ʿilman wa nūran wa ḥilman, wa ātinā niʿmatan ẓāhiratan wa niʿmatan bāṭinah. Ḥasbunā llāhu li-dīninā,
O Allāh, increase us in knowledge and light and forbearance, and give us an outward blessing and an inward blessing. Allāh suffices us for our religion,
حَسْبُنَا الـلّٰـهُ لِدُنْيَانَا، حَسْبُنَا الـلّٰـهُ الكَرِيْـمُ لِمَا أَمَـمَّنَا، حَسْبُنَا الْـحَلِيْمُ الْقَوِىُّ لِمَنْ بَغَىٰ عَلَيْنَا،
ḥasbunā llāhu li-dunyānā; ḥasbunā llāhu l-Karīmu li-mā ahammanā; ḥasbunā l-Ḥalīmu l-Qawiyyu li-man baghā ʿalaynā,
Allāh suffices us for our worldly life; Allāh the Generous suffices us for whatever weighs on us; the Forbearing, the Strong suffices us against whoever transgresses upon us,
حَسْبُنَا الـلّٰـهُ الشَّدِيْدُ لِمَنْ كَادَنَا بِسُوْءٍ، حَسْبُنَا الـلّٰـهُ الْكَرِيْـمُ عِنْدَ الْـحِسَابِ،
ḥasbunā llāhu sh-Shadīdu li-man kādanā bi-sūʾin; ḥasbunā llāhu l-Karīmu ʿinda l-ḥisāb,
Allāh the Severe suffices us against whoever plots evil against us; Allāh the Generous suffices us at the reckoning,
حَسْبُنَا الـلّٰـهُ اللَّطِيْفُ عِنْدَ الْمِيزَانِ، حَسْبُنَا الـلّٰـهُ الْـحَكِيْمُ عِنْدَ الْـجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ،
ḥasbunā llāhu l-Laṭīfu ʿinda l-mīzān; ḥasbunā llāhu l-Ḥakīmu ʿinda l-jannati wa n-nār,
Allāh the Subtle suffices us at the Balance; Allāh the Wise suffices us at the Garden and the Fire,
حَسْبُنَا الـلّٰـهُ الْقَدِيْرُ عِنْدَ الصَّرَاطِ، حَسْبِـيَ الـلّٰـهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ.
ḥasbunā llāhu l-Qadīru ʿinda ṣ-ṣirāṭ. Ḥasbiya llāhu lā ilāha illā huwa; ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīm.
Allāh the All-Powerful suffices us at the Bridge. Allāh is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. In Him I place my trust, and He is Lord of the Mighty Throne.

مَرْحَبًا مَرْحَبًا بِالصَّبَاحِ وَبِالْيَوْمِ الْـجَدِيْدِ، وَبِالْإِيَّانِ وَبِالْفَيْنَةِ السَّعِيْدِ وَبِالسَّافِرِ وَالشَّهِيْدِ اكْتُبْ لَنَا مَا نَقُوْلُ بِسْمِ الـلّٰـهِ الْـحَمِيْدِ الْمَجِيْدِ الرَّفِيْعِ الْوَدُوْدِ الْمُحِيْطِ الْفَعَالِ فِـيْ خَلْقِهِ لِمَا يُرِيدُ،

Marḥaban marḥaban bi-ṣ-ṣabāḥi wa bi-l-yawmi l-jadīd, wa bi-l-iyyāni wa bi-l-faynati s-saʿīd, wa bi-s-sāfiri wa sh-shahīd. Uktub lanā mā naqūl: bismi llāhi l-Ḥamīdi l-Majīdi r-Rafīʿi l-Wadūdi l-Muḥīṭi l-Faʿʿāli fī khalqihi li-mā yurīd,

Welcome, welcome to the morning and to the new day, to the appointed time and to the happy hour, to the one who departs and the one who witnesses. Write down for us what we say: in the name of Allāh, the Praiseworthy, the Glorious, the Exalted, the Loving, the All-Encompassing, the Doer in His creation of whatever He wills,
وَهُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيْدِ، أَصْحَبْنَا بِالـلّٰـهِ مُؤْمِنًا وَبِلِقَآئِهِ مُصَدِّعًا وَبِـحُجَّتِهِ مُعْتَرِفًا وَلِسِوَى الـلّٰـهِ فِي الْأُلُوْهِيَّةِ جَاحِدًا،
wa huwa aqrabu ilayhi min ḥabli l-warīd. Aṣbaḥnā bi-llāhi muʾminan, wa bi-liqāʾihi muṣaddiqan, wa bi-ḥujjatihi muʿtarifan, wa li-siwā llāhi fī l-ulūhiyyati jāḥidan,
and He is nearer to him than the jugular vein. We have entered the morning believing in Allāh, affirming the meeting with Him, acknowledging His proof, and denying divinity to all besides Allāh,
وَعَلَى الـلّٰـهِ مُتَوَكِّلَا نُشْهِدُ الـلّٰـهَ وَنُشْهِدُ مَلَآئِكَتَهُ وَكُتُبِهِ ۚ وَأَنْبِيَانَهُ وَحَمَلَةَ عَرْشِهِ بِأَنَّهُ هُوَ الـلّٰـهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ،
wa ʿalā llāhi mutawakkilan. Nushhidu llāha wa nushhidu malāʾikatahu wa kutubahu wa anbiyāʾahu wa ḥamalata ʿarshihi bi-annahu huwa llāhu lladhī lā ilāha illā huwa,
and relying upon Allāh. We call Allāh to witness, and His angels and His books and His prophets and the bearers of His Throne, that He is Allāh, other than whom there is no god,
وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، وَنَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُـحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوْلُهُ، وَأَنَّ الْـجَنَّةَ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارَ حَقٌّ،
waḥdahu lā sharīka lah; wa nashhadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh; wa anna l-jannata ḥaqqun, wa n-nāra ḥaqq,
alone, without partner; and we bear witness that Muḥammad is His servant and His Messenger; and that the Garden is true and the Fire is true,
وَأَنَّ الْـحَوْضَ حَقٌّ، وَأَنَّ الشَّفَاعَةَ حَقٌّ، وَأَنَّ مُنْكَرًا وَّنَكيْرًا حَقٌّ، وَوَعْدَكَ حَقٌّ، وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيْهَا،
wa anna l-ḥawḍa ḥaqq, wa anna sh-shafāʿata ḥaqq, wa anna Munkaran wa Nakīran ḥaqq, wa waʿdaka ḥaqq, wa anna s-sāʿata ātiyatun lā rayba fīhā,
and that the Basin is true, and that the intercession is true, and that Munkar and Nakīr are true, and that Your promise is true, and that the Hour is coming, in which there is no doubt,
وَأَنَّ الـلّٰـهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُوْرِ، عَلَىٰ ذَلِكَ نَـحْيَـىٰ وَعَلَيْهِ نَـمُوْتُ وَعَلَيْهِ نُبْعَثُ غَدًا،
wa anna llāha yabʿathu man fī l-qubūr. ʿAlā dhālika naḥyā wa ʿalayhi namūtu wa ʿalayhi nubʿathu ghadan,
and that Allāh will raise up whoever is in the graves. Upon that we live, upon it we die, and upon it we shall be raised tomorrow,
وَلَا نَرَى عَذَابًا إِنْ شَآءَ الـلّٰـهُ تَعَالَـىٰ. اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا، فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا أَوْزَارَنَا الْكَبَآئِرَ وَاللَّمَمَ،
wa lā narā ʿadhāban in shāʾa llāhu taʿālā. Allāhumma innanā ẓalamnā anfusanā, fa-ghfir lanā awzāranā, al-kabāʾira wa l-lamam,
and we shall see no punishment, if Allāh Most High wills. O Allāh, we have wronged ourselves, so forgive us our burdens — the grave sins and the slight ones,
فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُهُـمَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَاهْدِنَا لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ،
fa-innahu lā yaghfiruhumā illā ant. Wa hdinā li-aḥsani l-akhlāq, fa-innahu lā yahdī li-aḥsanihā illā ant. Labbayka wa saʿdayk,
for none forgives them but You. And guide us to the noblest of characters, for none guides to the noblest of them but You. At Your service, and at Your pleasure,
وَالْـخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَدِكَ، نَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَنَتُوْبُ إِلَيْكَ آمَنَّا، اَللّٰهُمَّ بِـمَا أَرْسَلْتَ مِنْ رَسُوْلٍ وَآمَنَّا،
wa l-khayru kulluhu bi-yadik. Nastaghfiruka wa natūbu ilayk. Āmannā, Allāhumma, bi-mā arsalta min rasūlin wa āmannā,
and all good is in Your hand. We seek Your forgiveness and turn to You. We have believed, O Allāh, in every messenger You have sent, and we have believed,
اَللّٰهُمَّ بِـمَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ كِتَابٍ فَصَدَّقْنَا، اَللّٰهُمَّ امْلَأُ أَوْجُهَنَا مِنْكَ حَيَآءً، وَقُلُوْبَنَا مِنْكَ حُبُوْرًا.
Allāhumma bi-mā anzalta min kitābin fa-ṣaddaqnā. Allāhumma mlaʾ awjuhanā minka ḥayāʾan, wa qulūbanā minka ḥubūrā.
O Allāh, in every Book You have sent down, and so we have affirmed it. O Allāh, fill our faces with modesty before You, and our hearts with gladness from You.

اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا لَـهُوْمَا وَظَلْفًا، وَلَا تَـجْعَلْنَا ضَنِيَانًا وَعُمْيَانًا وَّنَـمِيْمًا وَنَفَاجًا وَدَاحِسًا، اَللّٰهُمَّ إنَّا نَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنَ الْـهَبْرَمَةِ وَالْـجَاوَةِ، وَمِنَ الْعُتُوِّ وَالْـخَطْرُبَةَ وَالْـخَيْلُوْلَةِ وَالْفَيْهَجِ وَالرَّتْعِ وَالْعَتْلِ، وَالرَّمَآءِ وَالْفِتْنَةِ الدَّهْـمَآءِ، وَالْمَعِيْشَةِ الضَّنْكَآءِ.

Allāhumma jʿalnā lahūman wa ẓalfan, wa lā tajʿalnā ḍaniyānan wa ʿumyānan wa namīman wa nafājan wa dāḥisā. Allāhumma innā naʿūdhu bika mina l-habramati wa l-jāwah, wa mina l-ʿutuwwi wa l-khaṭrabati wa l-khaylūlati wa l-fayhaji wa r-ratʿi wa l-ʿatl, wa r-ramāʾi wa l-fitnati d-dahmāʾ, wa l-maʿīshati ḍ-ḍankāʾ.

O Allāh, make us open-handed and restrained, and do not make us grudging, or blind, or slanderous, or boastful, or contentious. O Allāh, we take refuge in You from idle talk and from cruelty, from insolence and from wrangling, from obstruction and from dissipation, from indulgence and from harshness, from mutual shooting and from the black trial, and from a life of narrow straits.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوَّلَ يَوْمِنَا هَذَا صَلَاحًا، وَأَوْسَطَهُ فَلَاحًا، وَآخِرَهُ نَـجَاحًا. اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوَّلَهُ رَحْمَةٌ، وَأَوْسَطَهُ زَهَادَةً، وَآخِرَهُ تَكْرِمَةٌ.
Allāhumma jʿal awwala yawminā hādhā ṣalāḥan, wa awsaṭahu falāḥan, wa ākhirahu najāḥan. Allāhumma jʿal awwalahu raḥmatan, wa awsaṭahu zahādatan, wa ākhirahu takrimah.
O Allāh, make the beginning of this day of ours rightness, its middle success, and its end attainment. O Allāh, make its beginning mercy, its middle detachment, and its end honour.
اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا مِنَ الْعَيْشِ أَرْغَدَهُ، وَمِنَ الْعُمْرِ أَسْعَدَهُ، وَمِنَ الرِّزْقِ أَوْسَـمَهُ اَللّٰهُمَّ اعْفُ عَنَّا بِعَفْوِكَ، وَاحْلُمُ عَلَيْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ سُبْحَانَكَ.
Allāhumma rzuqnā mina l-ʿayshi arghadah, wa mina l-ʿumri asʿadah, wa mina r-rizqi awsaʿah. Allāhumma ʿfu ʿannā bi-ʿafwik, wa ḥlum ʿalaynā bi-faḍlika, subḥānak.
O Allāh, grant us the most ample of living, the happiest of lifetimes, and the widest of provision. O Allāh, pardon us by Your pardon, and bear with us by Your grace. Glory be to You.

اَللّٰهُمَّ وَبِـحَمْدِكَ، لَا أحْيِيْ تَنَآءً عَلَيْكَ، اَنْتَ كَمَا اَثْنَيْتَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِكَ عَزَّ جَارُكَ وَجَلٌ فَنَاؤُكَ، وَلَا يُهْزَمُ جُندُكَ وَلَا يُـخْلَفُ وَعْدُكَ، وَلَا إِلَـٰهَ غَيْرُكَ، سُبْحَانَكَ مَا عَبَدْنَاكَ حَقَّ عِبَادَتِكَ يَا مَعْبُوْدُ.

Allāhumma wa bi-ḥamdik. Lā uḥṣī thanāʾan ʿalayk; anta kamā athnayta ʿalā nafsik. ʿAzza jāruk, wa jalla thanāʾuk, wa lā yuhzamu junduk, wa lā yukhlafu waʿduk, wa lā ilāha ghayruk. Subḥānaka mā ʿabadnāka ḥaqqa ʿibādatika yā Maʿbūd.

O Allāh, and praise be to You. I cannot number the praise due to You; You are as You have praised Yourself. Mighty is the one under Your protection, sublime is Your praise, Your army is not defeated, Your promise is not broken, and there is no god but You. Glory be to You — we have not worshipped You as You deserve to be worshipped, O Worshipped One.
سُبْحَانَكَ مَا عَرَفْنَاكَ حَقَّ مَعْرَفَتِكَ يَا مَعْرُوفُ. سُبْحَانَكَ مَا ذَكَرْنَاكَ حَقَّ ذِكْرِكَ يَا مَذْكُوْرُ.
Subḥānaka mā ʿarafnāka ḥaqqa maʿrifatika yā Maʿrūf. Subḥānaka mā dhakarnāka ḥaqqa dhikrika yā Madhkūr.
Glory be to You — we have not known You as You deserve to be known, O Known One. Glory be to You — we have not remembered You as You deserve to be remembered, O Remembered One.

سُبْحَانَكَ مَا شَكَرْنَاكَ حَقَّ شُكْرِكَ يَا مَشْكُوْرُ. اَللّٰهُمَّ أَوْزِعْنَا شُكْرَ مَا أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا، فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الـلَّـهُ الَّذِي ارْتَفَعْتَ عَنْ صِفَةِ الْـجِيلِ صِفَاتُ قُدْرَتِكَ، وَلَا ضِدَّ شَهْدُكَ حِيْنَ فَطَرْتَ الْمَارُوْشَ، وَلَا يَدَّ حَجُرُكَ حِيْنَ بَرَآءَتِ الْـحَوَابَاتِ.

Subḥānaka mā shakarnāka ḥaqqa shukrika yā Mashkūr. Allāhumma awziʿnā shukra mā anʿamta bihi ʿalaynā; fa-innaka anta llāhu lladhi rtafaʿta ʿan ṣifati l-jīli ṣifātu qudratik, wa lā ḍidda shahdika ḥīna faṭarta l-mārūsh, wa lā yadda ḥajruka ḥīna baraʾati l-ḥawābāt.

Glory be to You — we have not thanked You as You deserve to be thanked, O One to whom thanks are due. O Allāh, inspire us to give thanks for what You have bestowed upon us; for You are Allāh, whose attributes of power are raised far above the description of any generation, who had no adversary when You brought forth what You made, and against whose restraining there was no hand when the created things came to be.
اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنْ حَجْمَةٍ لَّا تَدْمَعُ، وَمِنْ جَنَانٍ لَّا يَفْزَعُ، وَمِنْ قَلْبِ لَا يَـخْشَعُ وَمِنْ عَوَازِ الْمَاعُوْنَ.
Allāhumma innā naʿūdhu bika min ḥajmatin lā tadmaʿ, wa min janānin lā yafzaʿ, wa min qalbin lā yakhshaʿ, wa min ʿawāzi l-māʿūn.
O Allāh, we take refuge in You from an eye that does not weep, from a heart that is never moved, from a heart that is not humbled, and from the withholding of common kindness.
اَللّٰهُمَّ فَهَمْنَا أَسْرَارَكَ، وَالْبِسْنَا مَلَابِسَ أَنْوَارِكَ، وَاغْمِسْنَا فِي رَامُوْزِ اللَّطَآئِفِ،
Allāhumma fahhimnā asrārak, wa albisnā malābisa anwārik, wa ghmisnā fī rāmūzi l-laṭāʾif,
O Allāh, give us understanding of Your secrets, and clothe us in the garments of Your lights, and immerse us in the cipher of the subtleties,
وَافْضِ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ عَوَارِفِ الْمَعَارِفِ، يَا نُوْرَ الْأَنْوَارِ، يَا لَطِيفُ يَا سَتَّارُ، نَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ سَيّدِنَا مُـحَمَّدٍ نِبْرَاسِ الْأَنْبِيَآءِ،
wa afiḍ ʿalaynā min ʿawārifi l-maʿārif. Yā Nūra l-anwār, yā Laṭīfu yā Sattār: nasʾaluka an tuṣalliya ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nibrāsi l-anbiyāʾ,
and pour upon us of the gifts of the sciences of gnosis. O Light of lights, O Subtle, O Veiler: we ask You to bless our master Muḥammad, the lamp of the prophets,
وَنَيْرِ الْأَوْلِيَآءِ، وَزِبْرِقَانِ الْأَصْفِيَآءِ، وَيُوْحِ الثَّقَلَيْنِ، وَضِيَآءِ الْـخَافِقَيْنِ، وَأَنْ تَرْفَعَ وُجُوْدَنَا إِلَـىٰ فَلَكِ الْعِرْفَانِ،
wa nayyiri l-awliyāʾ, wa zibriqāni l-aṣfiyāʾ, wa rūḥi th-thaqalayn, wa ḍiyāʾi l-khāfiqayn; wa an tarfaʿa wujūdanā ilā falaki l-ʿirfān,
the luminary of the friends of God, the shining moon of the elect, the spirit of the two weighty worlds, and the radiance of the two horizons; and that You raise our being to the orbit of gnosis,
وتُثَبِّتَ شُهُوْدَنَا فِـيْ مَقَامِ الْإِحْسَانِ، يَا الـلّٰـهُ، يَا نُوْرُ، يَا وَاسِعُ، يَا غَفُوْرُ،
wa tuthabbita shuhūdanā fī maqāmi l-iḥsān. Yā Allāh, yā Nūr, yā Wāsiʿ, yā Ghafūr,
and establish our witnessing in the station of spiritual excellence. O Allāh, O Light, O All-Embracing, O Ever-Forgiving,

يَا مَنِ السَّمَآءُ بِأَمْرِهِ مَبْنِيَّةٌ وَّالْغَبْرَآءُ بِقُدْرَتِهِ مَدْحِيَّةٌ الـلّٰـهُ وَالشَّوَاهِقُ بِـحِكْمَتِهِ مُرْسِيَّةٌ وَّالْقَمَرَانِ ۚ بِفَضْلِهِ مُضِيْعَةٌ تَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْـمِكَ الَّذِي تَرَقْرَقَتْ مِنْهُ الْعُمْرُ وَالْأَزْهَرَانِ وَتَـجَلْجَلَتْ مِنْهُ الْمَنَانُ حِرْزَا مَانِعًا وَنُوْرًا سَاطِعًا،

yā mani s-samāʾu bi-amrihi mabniyyah, wa l-ghabrāʾu bi-qudratihi madḥiyyah, Allāhu — wa sh-shawāhiqu bi-ḥikmatihi mursiyyah, wa l-qamarāni bi-faḍlihi muḍīʾah. Nasʾaluka bi-smika lladhī taraqraqat minhu l-ghamru wa l-azharān, wa tajaljalat minhu l-mannān — ḥirzan māniʿan wa nūran sāṭiʿan,

O He by whose command the sky is built and by whose power the earth is spread, Allāh — by whose wisdom the high peaks are set firm and by whose grace the two moons shine. We ask You by Your name from which the deep waters and the two bright ones stream forth, and from which the abundant gifts resound — for a guarding refuge and a shining light,

يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِ يَذْهَبُ بِالأَبْصَارِ يُقَلِّبُ الـلّٰـهُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ إِنَّ فِـيْ ذَلِكَ لَعِبْرَةٌ لْأُوْلِي الْأَبْصَارِ (طٰسٓمّٓ( وَنَعُوْذُ بِالـلّٰـهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ مِنَ الْمَعَازِفِ وَالْعِضَةِ وَالْمَحْظُوْرِ، وَالْمُمَاحَلَةِ وَالْغِمَارِ،

yakādu sanā barqihi yadhhabu bi-l-abṣār. Yuqallibu llāhu l-layla wa n-nahār; inna fī dhālika la-ʿibratan li-ulī l-abṣār. ﴿Ṭā Sīn Mīm﴾ Wa naʿūdhu bi-llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīmi mina l-maʿāzifi wa l-ʿiḍati wa l-maḥẓūr, wa l-mumāḥalati wa l-ghimār,

the flash of His lightning all but takes away the sight. Allāh turns about the night and the day; surely in that is a lesson for those who have eyes to see. ⟨Ṭā Sīn Mīm⟩ And we take refuge in Allāh, the Most High, the Magnificent, from idle music and slander and what is forbidden, and from scheming and from the press of the crowd,
وَمِنْ كَيْدِ الْفُجَّارِ، وَمِنْ حَوَادِثِ الْعَصْرَانِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ الْأَجُرَّانِ، يَا حَفِيْظٌ احْفَظْنَا، يَا وَلِـيُّ،
wa min kaydi l-fujjār, wa min ḥawādithi l-ʿaṣrān, wa min sharri l-ajurrān. Yā Ḥafīẓu ḥfaẓnā. Yā Waliyy,
and from the plotting of the depraved, and from the accidents of the passing times, and from the evil of what is hurled at us. O Preserver, preserve us. O Protector,
يَا وَالِـيْ، يَا عَلِيُّ، يَا عَالِـيْ، يَا مَنْ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، لَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ كَيْفَ هُوَ إِلَّا هُوَ يا الـلّٰـهُ،
yā Wālī, yā ʿAliyy, yā ʿĀlī, yā man lā ilāha illā huwa, lā yaʿlamu aḥadun kayfa huwa illā huwa. Yā Allāh,
O Governor, O Most High, O Exalted, O He other than whom there is no god — none knows how He is but He. O Allāh,
يَا حَيُّ، يَا قَيُّومُ، يَا حَقُّ يَا وَاحِدُ، يَا أَحَدُ، يَا صَمَدُ يَا وَهَّابُ، يَا فَتَّاحُ يَا مُـحْيِيْ يَا مُـمِيْتُ، يَا قَهَّارُ،
yā Ḥayy, yā Qayyūm, yā Ḥaqq, yā Wāḥid, yā Aḥad, yā Ṣamad, yā Wahhāb, yā Fattāḥ, yā Muḥyī, yā Mumīt, yā Qahhār,
O Living, O Self-Subsisting, O Real, O One, O Unique, O Eternally Besought, O Bestower, O Opener, O Giver of life, O Giver of death, O Overwhelming,
﴿ سَلَـٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيْمٍۢ ﴾
﴿Salāmun qawlan min Rabbin Raḥīm﴾
⟨“Peace” — a word from a Merciful Lord.⟩
﴿فَسَيَكْفِيْكَهُمُ الـلّٰـهُ
﴿Fa-sayakfīkahumu llāhu
⟨Allāh will suffice you against them,

وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ﴾ هُوَ الـلّٰـهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوْسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْـجَبَّارُ الْـمُتَكَبِّرُ الْـخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْـمُصَوِّرُ الْغَفَّارُ الْقَهَّارُ الْوَهَّابُ الرَّزَّاقُ الْفَتَّاحُ الْعَلِيْمُ الْقَابِضُ الْبَاسِطُ الْـخَافِضُ الرَّافِعُ الْـمُعِزُّ الْـمُذِلُّ السَّمِيْعُ الْبَصِيْرُ الْـحَكَمُ الْعَدْلُ اللَّطِيْفُ الْـخَبِيْرُ الْـحَلِيْمُ الْعَظِيْمُ الْغَفُوْرُ الشَّكُوْرُ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيْرُ الْـحَفِيْظُ الْـمُقِيْتُ الْـحَسِيْبُ الْـجَلِيْلُ الْكَرِيْـمُ الرَّقِيْبُ الْـمُجِيْبُ الْوَاسِعُ الْـحَكِيْمُ الْوَدُوْدُ الْـمَجِيْدُ الْبَاعِثُ الشَّهِيْدُ الْـحَقُّ الْوَكِيْلُ الْقَوِيُّ الْـمَتِيْنُ الْوَلِـيُّ الْـحَمِيْدُ الْـمُحْصِيُ الْـمُبْدِئُ الْـمُعِيْدُ الْـمُحْيِيُ الْـمُمِيْتُ الْـحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ الْوَاجِدُ الْـمَاجِدُ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الْقَادِرُ الْـمُقْتَدِرُ الْـمُقَدِّمُ الْـمُؤَخِّرُ الْأَوَّلُ اْلآخِرُ الظَّاهِرُ الْبَاطِنُ الْوَالِـي الْـمُتَعَالِ الْبَرُّ التَّوَّابُ الْـمُنْتَقِمُ الْعَفُوُّ الرَّؤُوْفُ مَالِكُ الْـمُلْكِ ذُو الْـجَلَالِ

wa huwa s-Samīʿu l-ʿAlīm﴾. Huwa llāhu lladhī lā ilāha illā huwa: ar-Raḥmānu r-Raḥīmu l-Maliku l-Quddūsu s-Salāmu l-Muʾminu l-Muhayminu l-ʿAzīzu l-Jabbāru l-Mutakabbiru l-Khāliqu l-Bāriʾu l-Muṣawwiru l-Ghaffāru l-Qahhāru l-Wahhābu r-Razzāqu l-Fattāḥu l-ʿAlīmu l-Qābiḍu l-Bāsiṭu l-Khāfiḍu r-Rāfiʿu l-Muʿizzu l-Mudhillu s-Samīʿu l-Baṣīru l-Ḥakamu l-ʿAdlu l-Laṭīfu l-Khabīru l-Ḥalīmu l-ʿAẓīmu l-Ghafūru sh-Shakūru l-ʿAliyyu l-Kabīru l-Ḥafīẓu l-Muqītu l-Ḥasību l-Jalīlu l-Karīmu r-Raqību l-Mujību l-Wāsiʿu l-Ḥakīmu l-Wadūdu l-Majīdu l-Bāʿithu sh-Shahīdu l-Ḥaqqu l-Wakīlu l-Qawiyyu l-Matīnu l-Waliyyu l-Ḥamīdu l-Muḥṣī l-Mubdiʾu l-Muʿīdu l-Muḥyī l-Mumītu l-Ḥayyu l-Qayyūmu l-Wājidu l-Mājidu l-Wāḥidu l-Aḥadu ṣ-Ṣamadu l-Qādiru l-Muqtadiru l-Muqaddimu l-Muʾakhkhiru l-Awwalu l-Ākhiru ẓ-Ẓāhiru l-Bāṭinu l-Wālī l-Mutaʿālī l-Barru t-Tawwābu l-Muntaqimu l-ʿAfuwwu r-Raʾūfu Māliku l-mulki Dhū l-jalāl

and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.⟩ He is Allāh, other than whom there is no god: the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful, the King, the All-Holy, the Peace, the Granter of Security, the Guardian, the Mighty, the Compeller, the Supremely Great, the Creator, the Maker, the Fashioner, the Ever-Forgiving, the Overwhelming, the Bestower, the Provider, the Opener, the All-Knowing, the Withholder, the Expander, the Abaser, the Exalter, the Honourer, the Humbler, the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing, the Judge, the Just, the Subtle, the All-Aware, the Forbearing, the Magnificent, the Forgiving, the Appreciative, the Most High, the Great, the Preserver, the Sustainer, the Reckoner, the Sublime, the Generous, the Watchful, the Answerer, the All-Embracing, the Wise, the Loving, the Glorious, the Raiser of the dead, the Witness, the Real, the Trustee, the Strong, the Firm, the Protector, the Praiseworthy, the Reckoner of all, the Originator, the Restorer, the Giver of life, the Giver of death, the Living, the Self-Subsisting, the Finder, the Noble, the One, the Unique, the Eternally Besought, the Able, the All-Powerful, the Advancer, the Delayer, the First, the Last, the Outward, the Inward, the Governor, the Exalted, the Source of goodness, the Ever-Relenting, the Avenger, the Pardoner, the Most Kind, Owner of all dominion, Possessor of majesty

وَالْإِكْرَامِ الْـمُقْسِطُ الْـجَامِعُ الْغَنِـيُّ الْـمُغْنِـي الْـمَانِعُ الضَّارُ النَّافِعُ النُّوْرُ الْـهَادِي الْبَدِيْعُ الْبَاقِي الْوَارِثُ الرَّشِيْدُ الصَّبُوْرُ الَّذِي لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ وَّهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْبَصِيْرُ.
wa l-ikrāmi l-Muqsiṭu l-Jāmiʿu l-Ghaniyyu l-Mughnī l-Māniʿu ḍ-Ḍārru n-Nāfiʿu n-Nūru l-Hādī l-Badīʿu l-Bāqī l-Wārithu r-Rashīdu ṣ-Ṣabūr — alladhī laysa ka-mithlihi shayʾun wa huwa s-Samīʿu l-Baṣīr.

and honour, the Equitable, the Gatherer, the Self-Sufficient, the Enricher, the Withholder, the One who allows harm, the Bringer of benefit, the Light, the Guide, the Originator, the Everlasting, the Inheritor, the Right-Guiding, the Patient — He, the like of whom there is nothing, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.

حَسْبُنَا الـلّٰـهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ، نِعْمَ الْـمَوْلَـىٰ، وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيْرُ، غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْـمَصِيْرُ، يَا دَآئِمًا بِلَا فَنَآءِ، يَا بَاقِيًا بِلَا زَوَالٍ، وَيَا مُدَبِّرًا بِلَا وَزِيْرٍ سَهِلْ عَلَيْنَا، وَعَلَىٰ وَأَبَوَيْنَا كُلَّ عَسِيرٍ.

Ḥasbunā llāhu wa niʿma l-wakīl, niʿma l-mawlā wa niʿma n-naṣīr. Ghufrānaka Rabbanā wa ilayka l-maṣīr. Yā Dāʾiman bi-lā fanāʾ, yā Bāqiyan bi-lā zawāl, wa yā Mudabbiran bi-lā wazīr: sahhil ʿalaynā wa ʿalā abawaynā kulla ʿasīr.

Allāh suffices us — an excellent guardian, an excellent protector and an excellent helper. Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the journey's end. O Everlasting without ceasing, O Abiding without passing away, O Governor without any minister: make easy for us and for our parents every difficulty.

اللّٰهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا رَادَّ لِمَا قَضَيْتَ، وَلَا مُيَسِّرَ لِمَا عَسَّرْتَ، وَلَا مُعَسِّرَ لِمَا يَسَّرْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْـجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْـجَدُّ.
Allāhumma lā māniʿa li-mā aʿṭayt, wa lā muʿṭiya li-mā manaʿt, wa lā rādda li-mā qaḍayt, wa lā muyassira li-mā ʿassart, wa lā muʿassira li-mā yassart. Wa lā yanfaʿu dhā l-jaddi minka l-jadd.

O Allāh, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold; none can turn back what You decree; none can make easy what You have made hard, and none can make hard what You have made easy. And the fortune of the fortunate avails him nothing against You.

سُبْحَانَ رَبِّـيَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ الْـحَسِيْبُ الْـحَكَمُ الْعَدْلُ الرَّقِيْبُ الْبَاذِخُ الشَّامِحُ الْمُجِيْبُ الْغَنِـيُّ الرَّشِيْدُ الصَّبُوْرُ الْـجَلِيلُ الْبَدِيْعُ النُّوْرُ الْمُقْسِطُ الْـجَامِعِ الْمُعْطِيُ الْمَانِ.
Subḥāna Rabbiya l-ʿAliyyu l-ʿAẓīmu l-Ḥasību l-Ḥakamu l-ʿAdlu r-Raqību l-Bādhikhu sh-Shāmiḥu l-Mujību l-Ghaniyyu r-Rashīdu ṣ-Ṣabūru l-Jalīlu l-Badīʿu n-Nūru l-Muqsiṭu l-Jāmiʿu l-Muʿṭī l-Māniʿ.

Glory be to my Lord — the Most High, the Magnificent, the Reckoner, the Judge, the Just, the Watchful, the Lofty, the Towering, the Answerer, the Self-Sufficient, the Right-Guiding, the Patient, the Sublime, the Originator, the Light, the Equitable, the Gatherer, the Giver, the Withholder.
لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا الـلّٰـهُ الْوَكِيْلُ الشَّهِيْدُ. لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا الـلّٰـهُ الْمَتِينُ الْمَجِيْدُ. لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا الـلّٰـهُ الْوَاجِدُ الْوَالِـيْ.
Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-Wakīlu sh-Shahīd. Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-Matīnu l-Majīd. Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-Wājidu l-Wālī.
There is no god but Allāh, the Trustee, the Witness. There is no god but Allāh, the Firm, the Glorious. There is no god but Allāh, the Finder, the Governor.
لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا الـلّٰـهُ الْمَاجِدُ الْمُتَعَالِ أَعْدَدْنَا لِكُلِّ هَوْلٍ لَّا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا الـلّٰـهُ.
Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-Mājidu l-Mutaʿāl. Aʿdadnā li-kulli hawlin lā ilāha illā llāh.
There is no god but Allāh, the Noble, the Exalted. For every terror we have made ready: there is no god but Allāh.
وَلِكُلِّ رِغْسِ الْـحَمْدُ لِـلّٰـهِ، وَلِكُلِّ رَخَآءِ الشُّكْرُ الـلّٰـهِ، وَلِكُلِّ أَعْجُوْبَةٍ سُبْحَانَ الـلّٰـهِ،
Wa li-kulli righsin al-ḥamdu li-llāh; wa li-kulli rakhāʾin ash-shukru li-llāh; wa li-kulli uʿjūbatin subḥāna llāh,
And for every abundance: praise be to Allāh. And for every ease: thanks be to Allāh. And for every wonder: glory be to Allāh,
وَلِكُلِّ لَزَنٍ حَسْبِـيَ الـلّٰـهُ وَلِكُلِّ إِثْـمٍ أَسْتَغْفِرُ الـلّٰـهَ، وَلِكُلِّ شَجْوِ مَا شَآءَ الـلّٰـهُ،
wa li-kulli lazanin ḥasbiya llāh; wa li-kulli ithmin astaghfiru llāh; wa li-kulli shajwin mā shāʾa llāh,
and for every hardship: Allāh suffices me. And for every sin: I seek Allāh's forgiveness. And for every grief: what Allāh wills,

وَلِكُلِّ قَضَآءٍ وَّقَدَرٍ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى الـلّٰـهِ، وَلِكُلِّ مُصِيْبَةٍ إِنَّا لِـلّٰـهِ وَلِكُلِّ طَاعَةٍ وَّمَعْصِيَةٍ لَّا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِالـلّٰـهِ وَلِكُلِّ شَجَبٍ اسْتَعَنْتُ بِالـلّٰـهِ،
wa li-kulli qaḍāʾin wa qadarin tawakkaltu ʿalā llāh; wa li-kulli muṣībatin innā li-llāh; wa li-kulli ṭāʿatin wa maʿṣiyatin lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi-llāh; wa li-kulli shajabin istaʿantu bi-llāh.

and for every decree and destiny: I rely upon Allāh. And for every affliction: truly we belong to Allāh. And for every act of obedience and of disobedience: there is no power and no strength save by Allāh. And for every distress: I seek help from Allāh.

اللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا أَصْبَحْنَا نُشْهِدُكَ وَنُشْهِدُ مَلَآئِكَتِكَ وَحَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَأَنْبِيَآئِكَ وَجَمِيْعِ خَلْقِكَ بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ الـلّٰـهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ وَأَنَّ مُـحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُوْلُكَ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِالـلّٰـهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمْ.

Allāhumma innā aṣbaḥnā nushhiduka wa nushhidu malāʾikataka wa ḥamalata ʿarshika wa anbiyāʾaka wa jamīʿa khalqika bi-annaka anta llāhu lladhī lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, wa anna Muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk. Wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿAliyyi l-ʿAẓīm.

O Allāh, we have entered the morning calling You to witness, and calling to witness Your angels and the bearers of Your Throne and Your prophets and all Your creation, that You are Allāh, other than whom there is no god, alone, without partner; and that Muḥammad is Your servant and Your Messenger. And there is no power and no strength save by Allāh, the Most High, the Magnificent.
يَا رَحْمَٰنَ الدُّنْيَا، وَيَا رَحِيْمَ الْآخِرَةِ، فَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا اَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا وَاَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
Yā Raḥmāna d-dunyā, wa yā Raḥīma l-ākhirah: fa-ʿfu ʿannā wa ghfir lanā wa rḥamnā. Anta mawlānā wa anta khayru r-rāḥimīn.
O All-Merciful of this world, O Ever-Merciful of the next: pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, and You are the best of those who show mercy.
بِسْمِ الـلّٰـهِ الشَّافِي هُوَ الـلّٰـهُ، بِسْمِ الـلّٰـهِ الْكَافِي هُوَ الـلّٰـهُ، بِسْمِ الـلّٰـهِ الْمُعَافِي هُوَ الـلّٰـهُ،
Bismi llāhi sh-Shāfī huwa llāh; bismi llāhi l-Kāfī huwa llāh; bismi llāhi l-Muʿāfī huwa llāh,
In the name of Allāh the Healer — He is Allāh. In the name of Allāh the Sufficer — He is Allāh. In the name of Allāh the Granter of well-being — He is Allāh,
بسمِ الـلّٰـهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسـْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَآءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمِ ﴿فالـلّٰـهُ خَيْرٌ حَافِظًا
bismi llāhi lladhī lā yaḍurru maʿa smihi shayʾun fī l-arḍi wa lā fī s-samāʾ, wa huwa s-Samīʿu l-ʿAlīm. ﴿Fa-llāhu khayrun ḥāfiẓan
in the name of Allāh, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can do harm; and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. ⟨Allāh is the best keeper,
وَّهُوَ اَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ﴾ ﴿ وَالـلّٰـهُ مِنْ وَّرَآئِهِمْ مُّـحِيْطٌ ﴾ ﴿ بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَّـجِيْدٌ ﴾ ﴿ فِـيْ لَوْحٍ مَّـحْفُوْظٍ ﴾ ﴿حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ
wa huwa Arḥamu r-rāḥimīn﴾ ﴿Wa llāhu min warāʾihim muḥīṭ﴾ ﴿Bal huwa Qurʾānun majīd﴾ ﴿Fī lawḥin maḥfūẓ﴾ ﴿Ḥāfiẓū ʿalā ṣ-ṣalawāti
and He is the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.⟩ ⟨And Allāh encompasses them from behind.⟩ ⟨Rather, it is a glorious Qurʾān⟩ ⟨upon a Preserved Tablet.⟩ ⟨Keep guard over the prayers,
وَالصَّلَاةِ الْوُسْطَىٰ وَقُومُوا لِـلّٰـهِ قَانِتِيْنَ﴾ ﴿ إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ ﴾ نِعْمَ الْـحَافِظُ الـلّٰـهُ،
wa ṣ-ṣalāti l-wusṭā, wa qūmū li-llāhi qānitīn﴾ ﴿In kullu nafsin lammā ʿalayhā ḥāfiẓ﴾. Niʿma l-ḥāfiẓu llāh,
and the middle prayer, and stand before Allāh devoutly.⟩ ⟨There is no soul but has over it a keeper.⟩ How excellent a keeper is Allāh,
يَا حَافِظُ احْفَظْنَا ﴿ثُـمَّ أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّنْ بَعْدِ الْغَمِّ أَمَنَةٌ نُّعَاسًا يَّغْشَى طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنْكُمْ
yā Ḥāfiẓu ḥfaẓnā. ﴿Thumma anzala ʿalaykum min baʿdi l-ghammi amanatan nuʿāsan yaghshā ṭāʾifatan minkum,
O Preserver, preserve us. ⟨Then He sent down upon you, after the grief, a security — a drowsiness overtaking a party of you,

وَطَآئِفَةٌ قَدْ أَهَـمَّتْهُمْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ يَظُنُّونَ بِالـلّٰـهِ غَيْرَ الْـحَقِّ ظَنَّ الْـجَاهِلِيَّةِ يَقُوْلُوْنَ هَلْ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَمْرِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ قُلْ إِنَّ الْأَمْرَ كُلَّهُ لِـلّٰـهِ يُـخْفُوْنَ فِـيْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ مَّا لَا يُبْدُوْنَ لَكَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ لَوْ كَانَ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَمْرِ شَيْءٌ مَا قُتِلْنَا هَاهُنَا قُلْ لَوْ كُنْتُمْ فِـيْ بُيُوْتِكُمْ لَبَرَزَ الَّذِيْنَ كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَتْلُ إِلَـىٰ مَضَاجِعِهِمْ

wa ṭāʾifatun qad ahammathum anfusuhum yaẓunnūna bi-llāhi ghayra l-ḥaqqi ẓanna l-jāhiliyyah. Yaqūlūna hal lanā mina l-amri min shayʾ? Qul inna l-amra kullahu li-llāh. Yukhfūna fī anfusihim mā lā yubdūna lak. Yaqūlūna law kāna lanā mina l-amri shayʾun mā qutilnā hāhunā. Qul law kuntum fī buyūtikum la-baraza lladhīna kutiba ʿalayhimu l-qatlu ilā maḍājiʿihim,

while another party was concerned only for themselves, thinking of Allāh otherwise than the truth — the thought of the age of ignorance. They say: have we any part in the matter? Say: the matter belongs entirely to Allāh. They hide within themselves what they do not disclose to you. They say: had we had any part in the matter, we would not have been killed here. Say: had you been in your houses, those for whom killing was decreed would have gone forth to the places where they fell,

وَلِيَبْتَلِيَ الـلّٰـهُ مَا فِـيْ صُدُوْرِكُمْ وَلِيُمَحِّصِ مَا فِـيْ قُلُوْبِكُمْ وَالـلّٰـهُ عَلِيْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ الَّذِيْنَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا
wa li-yabtaliya llāhu mā fī ṣudūrikum wa li-yumaḥḥiṣa mā fī qulūbikum. Wa llāhu ʿalīmun bi-dhāti ṣ-ṣudūr. Alladhīna yaqūlūna Rabbanā innanā āmannā fa-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā,
and so that Allāh might test what is in your breasts and purge what is in your hearts. And Allāh knows what is within the breasts. Those who say: our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us our sins,
وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الصَّابِرِيْنَ وَالصَّادِقِيْنَ وَالْقَانِتِيْنَ وَالْمُنْفِقِيْنَ وَالْمُسْتَغْفِرِيْنَ بِالْأَسْحَارِ﴾ ﴿شَهِدَ الـلّٰـهُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
wa qinā ʿadhāba n-nār — aṣ-ṣābirīna wa ṣ-ṣādiqīna wa l-qānitīna wa l-munfiqīna wa l-mustaghfirīna bi-l-asḥār﴾ ﴿Shahida llāhu annahu lā ilāha illā huwa,
and guard us from the punishment of the Fire — the patient, the truthful, the devout, those who spend, and those who seek forgiveness before dawn.⟩ ⟨Allāh bears witness that there is no god but He,

وَالْمَلَآئِكَةُ وَأُوْلُوا الْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًا بِالْقِسْطِ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْـحَكِيْمُ﴾ ﴿ إِنَّ الدِّيْنَ عِنْدَ الـلّٰـهِ الْإِسْلَامُ ﴾ ﴿فَسُبْحَانَ الـلّٰـهِ حِيْنَ تُـمْسُوْنَ
wa l-malāʾikatu wa ulū l-ʿilmi qāʾiman bi-l-qisṭ. Lā ilāha illā huwa l-ʿAzīzu l-Ḥakīm﴾ ﴿Inna d-dīna ʿinda llāhi l-Islām﴾ ﴿Fa-subḥāna llāhi ḥīna tumsūna
and the angels and those of knowledge, upholding justice. There is no god but He, the Mighty, the Wise.⟩ ⟨Truly the religion with Allāh is Islam.⟩ ⟨So glory be to Allāh when you enter evening
وَحِيْنَ تُصْبِحُوْنَ﴾ ﴿ وَلَهُ الْـحَمْدُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَّحِيْنَ تُظْهِرُونَ ﴾ ﴿يُـخْرِجُ الْـحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ
wa ḥīna tuṣbiḥūn﴾ ﴿Wa lahu l-ḥamdu fī s-samāwāti wa l-arḍi wa ʿashiyyan wa ḥīna tuẓhirūn﴾ ﴿Yukhriju l-ḥayya mina l-mayyit,
and when you enter morning⟩ ⟨and His is the praise in the heavens and the earth, and at nightfall and when you reach noon.⟩ ⟨He brings forth the living from the dead,
وَيُـخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْـحَيِّ وَيُـحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِـهَا وَكَذَلِكَ تُـخْرَجُوْنَ﴾ ﴿إِنِّـيْ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى الـلّٰـهِ رَبّـِيْ
wa yukhriju l-mayyita mina l-ḥayy, wa yuḥyī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā, wa kadhālika tukhrajūn﴾ ﴿Innī tawakkaltu ʿalā llāhi rabbī
and brings forth the dead from the living, and gives life to the earth after its death; and thus shall you be brought forth.⟩ ⟨I have placed my trust in Allāh, my Lord
وَرَبِّكُمْ مَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا إِنَّ رَبّـِيْ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ ﴿وَمَا لَنَا الَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى الـلّٰـهِ
wa rabbikum. Mā min dābbatin illā huwa ākhidhun bi-nāṣiyatihā. Inna rabbī ʿalā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm﴾ ﴿Wa mā lanā allā natawakkala ʿalā llāh
and your Lord. There is no creature but He holds it by its forelock. Truly my Lord is upon a straight path.⟩ ⟨And why should we not rely upon Allāh,
وَقَدْ هَدَانَا سُبُلَنَا وَلَنَصْبِرَنَّ عَلَىٰ مَا آذَيْتُمُوْنَا وَعَلَى الـلّٰـهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُتَوَكَّلُونَ﴾ ﴿قُلْ لَنْ يُّصِيْبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ الـلّٰـهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَانَا
wa qad hadānā subulanā? Wa la-naṣbiranna ʿalā mā ādhaytumūnā. Wa ʿalā llāhi fa-l-yatawakkali l-mutawakkilūn﴾ ﴿Qul lan yuṣībanā illā mā kataba llāhu lanā. Huwa mawlānā,

when He has guided us in our ways? And we shall surely endure the harm you do us. And in Allāh let those who trust place their trust.⟩ ⟨Say: nothing will befall us but what Allāh has decreed for us. He is our Protector,
وَعَلَى الـلّٰـهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ﴾ ﴿وَمَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى الـلّٰـهِ رِزْقُهَا
wa ʿalā llāhi fa-l-yatawakkali l-muʾminūn﴾ ﴿Wa mā min dābbatin fī l-arḍi illā ʿalā llāhi rizquhā,
and in Allāh let the believers place their trust.⟩ ⟨And there is no creature on the earth but its provision rests with Allāh,
وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا كُلٌّ فِـيْ كِتَابٍ مُّبِيْنٍ﴾ ﴿وَكَاَيِّنَ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ لَا تَـحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا الـلّٰـهُ يَرْزُقُهَا
wa yaʿlamu mustaqarrahā wa mustawdaʿahā. Kullun fī kitābin mubīn﴾ ﴿Wa ka-ayyin min dābbatin lā taḥmilu rizqahā, Allāhu yarzuquhā
and He knows its dwelling place and its resting place. All is in a clear Book.⟩ ⟨And how many a creature bears not its own provision — Allāh provides for it
وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ﴾ ﴿مَا يَفْتَحِ الـلّٰـهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِنْ رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُـمْسِكَ لَـهَا
wa iyyākum, wa huwa s-Samīʿu l-ʿAlīm﴾ ﴿Mā yaftaḥi llāhu li-n-nāsi min raḥmatin fa-lā mumsika lahā,
and for you; and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.⟩ ⟨Whatever mercy Allāh opens to mankind, none can withhold it,
وَمَا يُـمْسِكُ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزْ الْـحَكِيْمُ﴾ ﴿وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَوَاتِ
wa mā yumsiku fa-lā mursila lahu min baʿdih; wa huwa l-ʿAzīzu l-Ḥakīm﴾ ﴿Wa la-in saʾaltahum man khalaqa s-samāwāti
and whatever He withholds, none can release it after Him; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.⟩ ⟨And if you ask them who created the heavens

وَالْاَرْضَ لَيَقُوْلُنَّ الـلّٰـهُ قُلْ أَفَرَأَيْتُمْ مَا تَدْعُوْنَ مِن دُونِ الـلّٰـهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِـيَ الـلّٰـهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَاشِفَاتُ ضُرِهِ أَوْ أَرَادَنِـي بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُـمْسِكَاتُ رَحْمَتِهِ قُلْ حَسْبِـيَ الـلّٰـهُ عَلَيْهَ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكَّلُوْنَ﴾ ﴿وَمَا جَعَلَهُ الـلّٰـهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَى لَكُمْ

wa l-arḍa la-yaqūlunna llāh. Qul a-fa-raʾaytum mā tadʿūna min dūni llāh: in arādaniya llāhu bi-ḍurrin hal hunna kāshifātu ḍurrih? Aw arādanī bi-raḥmatin hal hunna mumsikātu raḥmatih? Qul ḥasbiya llāh; ʿalayhi yatawakkalu l-mutawakkilūn﴾ ﴿Wa mā jaʿalahu llāhu illā bushrā lakum

and the earth, they will surely say: Allāh. Say: have you considered what you call upon besides Allāh? If Allāh intended harm for me, could they remove His harm? Or if He intended mercy for me, could they withhold His mercy? Say: Allāh suffices me; in Him do those who trust place their trust.⟩ ⟨And Allāh made it only as good tidings for you
وَلِتَطْمِئَنَّ قُلُوْبُكُمْ بِهِ وَمَا النَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِنْدِ الـلّٰـهِ الْعَزِيْزِ الْـحَكِيْمِ﴾ ﴿ كٓهٰيٰعٓصٓ ﴾ ﴿ حٰـمٓعٓسٓقٓ ﴾ اكْفِنَا
wa li-taṭmaʾinna qulūbukum bih. Wa mā n-naṣru illā min ʿindi llāhi l-ʿAzīzi l-Ḥakīm﴾ ﴿Kāf Hāʾ Yāʾ ʿAyn Ṣād﴾ ﴿Ḥā Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf﴾. Ikfinā
and so that your hearts might be at rest by it. And victory comes only from Allāh, the Mighty, the Wise.⟩ ⟨Kāf Hāʾ Yāʾ ʿAyn Ṣād⟩ ⟨Ḥā Mīm ʿAyn Sīn Qāf⟩. Suffice us

وَارْحَمْنَا هُوَ الـلّٰـهُ الْقَادِرُ الْقَاهِرُ، الظَّاهِرُ الْبَاطِنُ الْفَاطِرُ اللَّطِيْفُ الْـخَبِيْرُ ﴿ قَوْلُهُ الْـحَقُّ وَلَهُ الْمُلْكُ يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ عَالِـمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ وَهُوَ الْـحَكِيْمُ الْـخَبِيْرُ ﴾ يَا حَنَّانُ،

wa rḥamnā. Huwa llāhu l-Qādiru l-Qāhir, aẓ-Ẓāhiru l-Bāṭinu l-Fāṭiru l-Laṭīfu l-Khabīr. ﴿Qawluhu l-ḥaqqu wa lahu l-mulku yawma yunfakhu fī ṣ-ṣūr. ʿĀlimu l-ghaybi wa sh-shahādati wa huwa l-Ḥakīmu l-Khabīr﴾. Yā Ḥannān,

and have mercy on us. He is Allāh, the Able, the Overpowering, the Outward, the Inward, the Originator, the Subtle, the All-Aware. ⟨His word is the truth, and His is the dominion on the Day the trumpet is blown. Knower of the unseen and the seen — and He is the Wise, the All-Aware.⟩ O Ever-Compassionate,
يَا مَنَّانُ، يَا بَدِيْعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، يَا حَيُّ، يَا قَيُّومُ، يَا ذَا الْـجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ.
yā Mannān, yā Badīʿa s-samāwāti wa l-arḍ, yā Ḥayy, yā Qayyūm, yā Dhā l-jalāli wa l-ikrām.
O Ever-Bountiful, O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Living, O Self-Subsisting, O Possessor of majesty and honour.
نَسْأَلُكَ بِعِظَمِ اللَّاهُوْتِيَّةِ أَنْ تَنْقُلَ طِبَاعَنَا مِنْ طِبَاعِ الْبَشَرِيَّةِ، وَأَنْ تَرْفَعَ مُهَجَنَا مَعَ مَلَآئِكَتِكَ الْعُلْوِيَّةِ،
Nasʾaluka bi-ʿiẓami l-lāhūtiyyati an tanqula ṭibāʿanā min ṭibāʿi l-bashariyyah, wa an tarfaʿa muhajanā maʿa malāʾikatika l-ʿulwiyyah,
We ask You by the immensity of the divine realm that You transfer our natures out of the nature of mere humanity, and that You raise our inmost souls with Your angels of the higher world,
يَا مُـحَوّلَ الْـحَوْلِ وَالْأَحْوَالِ، حَوِّلْ حَالَنَا إِلَى أَحْسَنِ حَالِ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللّٰهُمَّ وَبِـحَمْدِكَ،
yā Muḥawwila l-ḥawli wa l-aḥwāl: ḥawwil ḥālanā ilā aḥsani ḥāl. Subḥānaka Allāhumma wa bi-ḥamdik,
O Turner of the year and of all states: turn our state to the best of states. Glory be to You, O Allāh, and praise be to You,
أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، اَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوْبُ إِلَيْكَ، اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ سَيّدِنَا مُـحَمَّدٍ السَّابِقِ إِلَى الْأَنَامِ نُورُهُ،
ashhadu an lā ilāha illā ant; astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk. Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin — as-sābiqi ilā l-anāmi nūruh,
I bear witness that there is no god but You; I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You. O Allāh, bless our master Muḥammad — whose light preceded all creatures,
رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِيْنَ ظُهُورُهُ، عَدَدَ مَنْ مَّضَى مِنَ الْبَرِيَّةِ، وَمَنْ بَقِىَ، وَمَنْ سَعِدَ مِنْهُمْ،
raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīna ẓuhūruh — ʿadada man maḍā mina l-bariyyah, wa man baqiya, wa man saʿida minhum,
whose appearing was a mercy to the worlds — by the number of those of creation who have passed away, and those who remain, and those among them who are felicitous,

وَمَنْ شَقِيَ، صَلَاةً تَسْتَغْرِقُ الْعَدَّ وَتُـحِيْطُ بِالْـحَدِّ، صَلَاةٌ لَّا غَايَةَ لَـهَا وَلَا انْتِهَآءَ وَلَا أَمَدَ لَـهَا وَلَا انْقِضَآءَ صَلَوَاتِكَ الَّتِـيْ صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةٌ دَآئِمَةٌ بِدَوَامِكَ،
wa man shaqiya. Ṣalātan tastaghriqu l-ʿadda wa tuḥīṭu bi-l-ḥadd; ṣalātan lā ghāyata lahā wa lā ntihāʾa, wa lā amada lahā wa lā nqiḍāʾ; ṣalawātika llatī ṣallayta ʿalayh — ṣalātan dāʾimatan bi-dawāmik,

and those who are wretched. A blessing that exhausts all number and encompasses every limit; a blessing that has no end and no ceasing, no term and no expiry; Your blessings with which You have blessed him — a blessing enduring with Your endurance,

وَعَلَىٰ آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ مِثْلَ ذٰلِكَ، ﴿ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوْنَ ﴾ ﴿ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ ﴾ ﴿ وَالْـحَمْدُ لِـلّٰـهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ ﴾ ﴿ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ ﴾
wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi mithla dhālik. ﴿Subḥāna Rabbika Rabbi l-ʿizzati ʿammā yaṣifūn﴾ ﴿Wa salāmun ʿalā l-mursalīn﴾ ﴿Wa l-ḥamdu li-llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn﴾ ﴿Bi-raḥmatika yā Arḥama r-rāḥimīn﴾

and upon his family and his Companions the like of that. ⟨Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe⟩ ⟨and peace be upon the messengers⟩ ⟨and praise be to Allāh, Lord of the worlds⟩ ⟨by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy.⟩
يَقْرأُ بَعْدَ الْختْمِ
Yuqraʾu baʿda l-khatm
To be recited after the completion
رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ. اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي كُلَّ خَيْرٍ وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍ صَلَوات شريفة
Rabbanā taqabbal minnā innaka anta s-Samīʿu l-ʿAlīm. Allāhumma aʿṭinī kulla khayrin wa aʿidhnī min kulli sharr. Ṣalawātun sharīfah:
Our Lord, accept from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. O Allāh, give me every good and shelter me from every evil. A noble invocation of blessing:
یَا اَحَدْ یَا صَمَدْ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُـحَمَّدْ
Yā Aḥad, yā Ṣamad, ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad.
O Unique, O Eternally Besought — bless Muḥammad.
al-Awrād al-Qudsiyya — 119 bands.
